verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe cross-device continuity: 'Remote Control' lets you continue work from phone/browser (docs-9), and 'claude --teleport' lets you start a task on web/mobile and pull it into your terminal later (docs-10), backed by browser/cloud session support (docs-13, docs-14, docs-26). missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of teleport and remote-control reliability across devices
